title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early Show) on 1970-01-03
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) > Sound Devices 744T > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with uneven volume and limited Garcia in the mix, yet a high‑energy show highlighted by superb Bob Weir playing and several genius moments.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its power, improvisational energy and overall “genius moments,” especially Bob Weir’s prominent and excellent guitar work. The soundboard source needs EQ tweaks—more bass, less treble—and has a wide dynamic range that can surprise listeners, with Garcia’s guitar surprisingly low in the mix. Despite these technical quirks the show is regarded as a good, uplifting Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted strong musical moments while noting moderate recording issues; the weighted average of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields a rating just above four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix requires EQ adjustments (raise bass, lower treble); very wide volume swing can be jarring; Garcia's guitar is low in the mix while Bob Weir is prominent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and improvisational, with a powerful overall vibe; reviewers emphasize the show’s genius moments and deep connection despite no specific song critiques.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Lead spot noted but his guitar is surprisingly low in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Prominent and playing excellently, highlighted by reviewers.
